subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Picking up my earlier email about first-purchase volume in the US. Since Temu and Shein slashed US ad spend through 2026 under the tariff and de minimis changes, shopping auctions have eased and the window to buy net-new first orders has opened, with blended US ecommerce CAC near $68 to $90 by vertical. That is the spread where confirmed-purchase optimization and a holdout decide your real cost per buyer. We hold out a control group so paid orders read as incremental to demand that would have converted anyway. Worth comparing against your mix?
angle: fresh angle: Temu/Shein 2026 US ad-spend pullback (sourced) + US ecommerce CAC band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce/US: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Temu/Shein US ad-spend pullback 2026, auctions easing) reusing only parent-named brands; sourced US ecommerce CAC band $68-$90 (eightx) + auction-easing source (DAC); MobUpps holdout reference, no figure; 1 question mark; native en; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
